info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-Create Warehouse Inventory Pick-v1-spec
info.description: The Warehouse Inventory Picking API facilitates the efficient management of inventory picking operations within a warehouse environment. This endpoint allows users to initiate the process of selecting and preparing items for shipment based on specific inventory requests. It is designed for warehouse managers, inventory control specialists, and logistics teams who require streamlined processes for fulfilling orders. By leveraging this API, organizations can optimize their inventory handling, improve order accuracy, and enhance overall operational efficiency.

post.description: This operation allows users to specify items to be picked from the inventory, handling the logistics of item selection and quantity management.

requestBody.description: Request body for picking items from inventory. This operation allows users to specify which items to pick, along with the quantities required. Ensure that the request matches the expected schema.

200.description: The request was successful, and the inventory pick operation completed without issues.
